using namespace std;

bool solve(long long w, long long m);

bool trySolve(long long w, long long m) {
    return m % w == 0 && solve(w, m / w);
}

bool solve(long long w, long long m) {
    if (w <= 3) {
        return true;
    }
    if (m <= 0) {
        return trySolve(w, m - 1) || trySolve(w, m) || trySolve(w, m + 1);
    }
    while (m > 0) {
        if (m % w == 0) {
            m /= w;
        } else if ((m - 1) % w == 0) {
            m = (m - 1) / w;
        } else if ((m + 1) % w == 0) {
            m = (m + 1) / w;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    long long w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    cout << (solve(w, m) ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
